summary: PR 1192 is accurate test-only hardening: its six tests pass unchanged on the recorded base and candidate, and it correctly rejects the earlier unsupported claim of a runtime fix. Independent real multiprocess collectives reproduce both reported unequal embedding-row contracts, but neither the candidate nor the available environment identifies or corrects the serving transition that creates rank-local row-count divergence.

tests.what_was_measured: The exact six candidate tests passed on the unmodified recorded base, demonstrating that the candidate is not a failing-before/passing-after runtime fix.
All six candidate tests passed at exact commit 27b34c2785e79791a4b900633329c5863fb6c131; the cuda parameter used the assigned gfx950 GPU.
Expected failure: two real Gloo ranks submitted (628,7168) and (1140,7168), exactly 4,501,504 and 8,171,520 elements, and the collective aborted on a received-size mismatch.
Expected failure: two real Gloo ranks submitted (6098,7168) and (9682,7168), exactly 43,710,464 and 69,400,576 elements, and the collective aborted on a received-size mismatch.

gpu_execution.evidence: The candidate's cuda-parameterized same-device overwrite test ran on one AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 using PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. This was not a multi-GPU collective or full serving test.

remaining_counterexamples: The candidate's fake TP group only copies a same-shaped local tensor; it cannot validate collective ordering, shape agreement, process-group participation, NCCL/RCCL behavior, or safe failure after divergence.
SGLANG_SPEC_TP_SYNC=off intentionally leaves divergent target samples unchanged and performs no divergence detection.
The AST assertion covers one DSpark target-prefill call site and does not prove all DSpark, scheduler, batching, or multimodal transitions keep TP batch membership and sequence lengths identical.
No evidence connects either recorded production collective sequence number to rank-local target sampling rather than another upstream state divergence.
The full Kimi-K3 TP=8 B300/NCCL serving workload and its original scheduler stall were not reproduced.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 was available; eight NVIDIA B300 GPUs, CUDA 13.0, and NCCL 2.28.3 were unavailable.
Kimi-K3 and DSpark model weights were unavailable.
The exact unequal-shape contract was reproduced with two CPU Gloo ranks, not the production NCCL process group.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes only tests and reports and has no native or runtime source changes.
